title: A change to the leak allowlist carries a planted check that a real value of the same kind still hits
goal: kb/_self/code.md and the worker role say that an item adding a tests_allowlist.txt entry carries a check that a real secret, address or id of the same kind, built at run time, still hits leak_hits with the new allowlist, beside the check that the quoted value passes

run:

sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
